title: Access removal and employee offboarding
text: For this fictional company, the identity team disables access for a departing employee within four hours of the approved termination time. The manager files an offboarding request. The security analyst verifies account disablement and session revocation in the next business-day review. Emergency departures are escalated immediately.

title: Privileged access review
text: Privileged access is reviewed every month by the resource owner. Reviewers confirm business justification, remove unnecessary roles and retain the approval record. New administrator access requires a separate approver and time-limited elevation.

title: Incident reporting and response
text: Report suspected security incidents to the security queue immediately. A critical incident is acknowledged within fifteen minutes during the fictional support window. Preserve log evidence and affected resource IDs. An incident commander coordinates investigation and customer communication.

title: Customer data retention
text: The fictional retention schedule keeps support case content for ninety days after case closure. Delete or anonymize it after that period unless an authorized legal hold applies. Analytics use aggregate counts and exclude customer identifiers. A data owner approves exceptions.

title: Remote device and login security
text: Remote work requires a managed device, disk encryption and multifactor authentication. An unexpected login prompt should be denied and reported. A lost device is reported immediately to IT so a separate authorized operator can assess access and lock options.

title: Business travel reimbursement
text: Travel reimbursement requests require an itemized receipt and manager approval. Submit a claim within thirty days of travel completion. Expenses outside the agreed travel budget need finance review before reimbursement; this assistant cannot approve or pay a claim.
